remaining_procedures.remaining_evidence: Freeze and execute the official-pair setup, safety, validation, UART, cache, guarded-action, cleanup, and reconnect matrix using exact probe/UART identities. Automated software evidence already passes.

Use real pack/device and linker evidence, a disposable application image, boundary artifacts, and backend traces proving sector-only containment and zero unsafe erase/write. Automated containment evidence already passes.

Run at most the designated single recovery on a positively identified recoverable board with fresh one-time permission; do not repeat a needless destructive erase. Automated recovery enforcement already passes.

Confirm real board/probe/UART release and reconnect with a client known to send cancellation and document a non-sending client if available. Timeout cleanup remains the guaranteed path. Automated subprocess and fake-backend lifecycle evidence already passes.

Attach both exact boards simultaneously and prove one-to-one assignment, board-specific validation/plans/permissions, cross-board concurrency, and disconnect isolation. Automated two-fake-board evidence already passes.
The server's structured permission, consumption, scope, and disclosure enforcement is automated; only whether a real human genuinely approved the value is intentionally a manual soft gate.
Server-generated relay text and no-internals instructions pass automated audits; a real agent client's choice to relay them faithfully is externally observable and cannot be enforced by the server.

safety_invariants: Every hardware phase has an explicit logical board and stable probe identity.
Every phase writes a machine-readable result below one clean external result root.
The wrong nRF52840 bench board is never substituted for nrf52833dk.
The preserved Nucleo M7 application flash is not repeated unless invalidated.
The nRF52833 application partition is flashed at most once when its board is available.
Mass erase occurs at most once and only after fresh unchanged-plan approval.
Lifecycle reuses preserved non-interruptible-flash evidence and does not flash again.
No bootloader flash or needless second recovery is planned.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: AST inspects the entrypoint and FastMCP stdio default.
cross_cutting.description: The Server serves exactly one local client on one computer, with no authentication and no network exposure. It must be unreachable from other machines.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: A hidden direct call is refused by the handler lock.
cross_cutting.description: Tool visibility is never authorization; every hidden tool is also functionally locked (AC-3.3).

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: All prohibited overlap shapes override broader classifications.
cross_cutting.description: Unknown memory is denied by default for every operation; prohibited classifications override all broader classifications.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Public schemas are recursively checked for authority/range/shell routes.
cross_cutting.description: The agent has no path to: persist state directly, supply allowed ranges, alter the user's part number, or open any gate (AC-6.5, AC-8.3, AC-8.5).

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Strings, commands, and unknown structured actions are rejected.
cross_cutting.description: No tool accepts arbitrary shell commands, including cleanup/finalizer parameters (AC-17.7).

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Mass erase refuses full-session and prior grants.
cross_cutting.description: Security/provisioning regions and mass erase are unavailable to ordinary workflows; mass erase requires fresh, range-disclosing user permission every time (AC-5.7, AC-15.2).

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Representative prompts are prose and exclude opaque identifiers/payload syntax.
cross_cutting.description: All server-originated content intended for the user is plain prose suitable for verbatim conversational relay; every response that requires user input or research includes an explicit instruction to the agent not to expose structured payloads, continuation tokens, or internal field names.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: The public command boundary excludes a user terminal/research-provider layer.
cross_cutting.description: There is no user-facing terminal-command layer and no separate research provider.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: A real MCP cancellation notification reaches managed cleanup.
cross_cutting.description: The Server interoperates with standard tool-calling agent clients (see Assumption A-1), including honoring client-issued request cancellation where the client sends it, and behaving safely (via timeouts and deterministic cleanup) where the client does not (see Open Question Q-1).

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: The recorded gate/freshness maximum is retained and compared with 250 ms.
cross_cutting.description: Gate/freshness checks add no more than 250 ms to a guarded call on a typical developer workstation.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Eight-probe/eight-port enumeration is measured against 10 seconds.
cross_cutting.description: Hardware enumeration at startup completes within 10 seconds for up to 8 attached probes/ports.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: NULL-plan and handshake are measured against 2 seconds.
cross_cutting.description: The all-`NULL` plan response and initialization handshake return within 2 seconds.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Every registered tool and dispatch call site has a positive finite timeout.

inspected_assertions.expression: assert calls, "the managed dispatch boundary must remain observable to this audit"

cross_cutting.description: Every operation has a finite timeout; no tool call can hang a Server Run indefinitely (AC-17.4).

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Ordinary unsafe mutations are rejected before backend calls.
cross_cutting.description: No single action available without destructive-recovery permission can leave the MCU permanently unrecoverable; application/bootloader crashes must remain recoverable through the Server's own reset/flash actions.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: All termination paths share cleanup and permit reuse.
cross_cutting.description: After any operation ends by any path, the next operation can reconnect without manual host intervention (AC-17.1â€“AC-17.5).

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Profile creation and staged updates are server owned.
cross_cutting.description: Profiles: created by setup, updated only by Server actions after validation, user-deletable as files; deleting a profile makes its name unknown at next resolution (routes to setup).

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Attempts are immutable and logs append only.

inspected_assertions.expression: assert all("recorded_at" in event for event in events)

cross_cutting.description: Reports/logs: one immutable structured record per setup/validation attempt; failures, research exchanges, and fingerprint changes are always recorded.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: Cache revocation is independent and persistent.
cross_cutting.description: Cache: revocable and regenerable at any time with no effect on profiles.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: All authority-bearing keys are rejected recursively.
cross_cutting.description: No secret material is persisted; nothing in the artifact store grants authority (artifacts never restore an open gate â€” AC-13.4).

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: The server interface is conversational prose plus structured agent control.
cross_cutting.description: The product's entire human interface is conversational text relayed by the agent; no requirement in this specification depends on a graphical interface, color, sound, or pointing device.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: All preflight prompts and friendly choices are inspected.
cross_cutting.description: All user-relayable text is in clear, jargon-minimal language; hardware choices are described by human-friendly distinguishing features (e.g., probe identifier endings), never raw internal identifiers alone.

cross_cutting.assertion_inspection: A non-ASCII display name survives commit and reload exactly.
cross_cutting.description: Initial release is English-only (Decision A-17; see Q-6). Display names supplied by the user may contain non-ASCII characters and must round-trip losslessly.
